Since they iterate value increasing, best[value+coin] hasn't been computed yet (still default amount+1). So they never update best[value] correctly. This is classic dp.transition-order: reading before writing.

Since best[amount] maybe amount+1 (default) > amount, returns -1. That's correct behavior for unreachable. But reference expects 1 reachable. So best[amount] is wrong.
